title: Give and receive feedback at work (B1)
summary: Đưa phản hồi cụ thể theo ví dụ-tác động-đề xuất và đón nhận phản hồi bằng cách tóm tắt, cảm ơn và hỏi thêm.
learningObjectives: Đưa phản hồi bằng ví dụ cụ thể và tác động
Đề xuất một thay đổi nhỏ
Đón nhận phản hồi bằng cách tóm tắt và hỏi thêm

sections.title: Feedback after a demo
sections.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Setting: after a team demo. You: Can I share some feedback on the demo? Colleague: Sure. Notes: use one specific example, describe its impact, offer a small suggestion. When you receive feedback, summarize it, say thank you and ask one question.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Nêu một ví dụ có thật thay vì nhận xét chung chung.
vocabulary.example: Let me give a specific example.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nhấn âm tiết thứ hai: spe-CIF-ic.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Điều xảy ra vì hành vi hoặc kết quả đó.
vocabulary.example: The impact was that people lost the thread.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Danh từ nhấn âm đầu: IM-pact.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Gợi ý một thay đổi nhỏ để làm tốt hơn.
vocabulary.example: I suggest starting with the main result.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nói I suggest + V-ing hoặc that-clause.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Phản hồi giúp người nhận cải thiện.
vocabulary.example: I hope this feedback is constructive.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nhấn âm tiết thứ hai: con-STRUC-tive.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Chấp nhận và sẽ áp dụng góp ý.
vocabulary.example: I will take that on board.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Dùng take ... on board, không nói take on the board.

expressions.phrase: Can I share some feedback on ___?
expressions.example: Can I share some feedback on the demo?
alternatives: Do you have a minute for feedback on ___?

expressions.phrase: When you ___, the impact was ___. Next time, you could ___.
expressions.meaning: Cấu trúc ví dụ, tác động, đề xuất.
expressions.example: When you showed ten slides, the impact was that people lost focus. Next time, you could start with the main result.
alternatives: One example is ___, and it led to ___.

expressions.phrase: So what I hear is ___. Thank you for pointing that out.
expressions.meaning: Tóm tắt phản hồi bạn nhận được.
expressions.example: So what I hear is that the demo needs a clearer start. Thank you for pointing that out.

expressions.phrase: Could you give me an example of ___?
expressions.meaning: Hỏi thêm ví dụ khi nhận phản hồi.
expressions.example: Could you give me an example of a better opening?
alternatives: What would that look like in practice?

exercises.question: Phản hồi nào cụ thể và hữu ích?
options: The demo opened with ten slides, so the main result came late.
The demo was kind of bad and I did not enjoy it at all.
You should be more confident and speak with more energy.
correctAnswer: The demo opened with ten slides, so the main result came late.
exercises.explanation: Phản hồi tốt có ví dụ và tác động.

exercises.question: Bạn nên đáp lại phản hồi như thế nào?
options: Summarize it and ask one question
Explain why the person is wrong about it
Stay silent and leave the room
correctAnswer: Summarize it and ask one question
exercises.explanation: Tóm tắt giúp bạn xác nhận đã hiểu đúng.

exercises.question: Điền từ: I will take that ___ board.
exercises.explanation: Take on board là cụm cố định.

exercises.question: Sắp xếp phản hồi theo thứ tự.
exercises.explanation: Xin phép, ví dụ, tác động, đề xuất.

sections.title: Ôn lại từ vựng của bài

exercises.question: Ghép từ với nghĩa của nó.
exercises.explanation: Ôn lại các từ đã học trong bài này.

exercises.question: Điền từ còn thiếu (cụ thể): Let me give a ___ example.
Điền từ còn thiếu (tác động): The ___ was that people lost the thread.

performanceTask.title: Give feedback, then respond to feedback
performanceTask.scenario: Sau buổi demo, bạn đưa phản hồi cho đồng nghiệp rồi nhận lại một phản hồi về chính bạn.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Nói bằng tiếng Anh trong khoảng một phút: đưa một phản hồi cụ thể với ví dụ, tác động và đề xuất, rồi đáp lại một phản hồi bằng cách tóm tắt và hỏi thêm. Chưa xem bài mẫu.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Speak in English for about one minute: give one piece of feedback with an example, impact and suggestion, then respond to feedback by summarizing it and asking one question.
performanceTask.modelResponse: Can I share some feedback on the demo? When you showed ten slides before the result, the impact was that people lost focus and the main point came late. Next time, you could start with the result and use two or three slides after that. I think the content was strong, and the live example was very clear. Now, about my part. You said my update was too long. So what I hear is that I should lead with the decision and keep the details short. Thank you for pointing that out. Could you give me an example of a better opening? I will take that on board and try a shorter version in the next meeting.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Speak again in English. Keep the example-impact-suggestion order and make your example more specific.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Give and receive feedback about a design doc instead of a demo.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Give and receive feedback in another situation without looking at old notes.

baseline.title: Feedback after a demo
baseline.brief: Sau demo, đồng nghiệp xin phản hồi và bạn cũng nhận phản hồi.

artifacts.title: Feedback after a demo
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Setting: after a team demo. You watched your colleague demo: ten slides came before the result, people lost focus and the main point came late. You liked the content and the live example. Afterwards the colleague gives you feedback: Your update was too long, and I could not find the decision.

retry.title: Feedback on a pull request
retry.brief: Sửa bài với tình huống review code của đồng nghiệp.

artifacts.title: Feedback on a pull request
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Setting: after a code review. Colleague: Could we talk about my last pull request? You noticed it had no tests. Afterwards the colleague gives you feedback: Your comments were helpful, but a few were hard to follow.

transfer.title: Feedback on a design doc
transfer.brief: Tình huống mới: tài liệu thiết kế khó đọc.

artifacts.title: Feedback on a design doc
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Setting: after a design review. Colleague: I would value your thoughts on my design doc. You found the diagrams unclear. Afterwards the colleague gives you feedback: Your questions were useful, but you spoke very fast.

review.title: Feedback on a customer call
review.brief: Ôn lại với cuộc gọi khách hàng.

artifacts.title: Feedback on a customer call
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Setting: after a customer call. Colleague: How did the call feel to you? You noticed they spoke very fast and the customer was lost. Afterwards the colleague gives you feedback: You waited a long time before you answered the customer.

anchors.met: The feedback has a real example, its impact and a suggestion.
anchors.notMet: Only general words such as "good" or "bad".

anchors.met: Restates the feedback and asks for an example.

rubric.label: Constructive tone
rubric.description: The tone is kind and professional.

anchors.notMet: Sounds like criticism of the person.

audio.text: Can I share some feedback on the demo?
When you showed ten slides, the impact was that people lost focus.
Next time, you could start with the main result.
So what I hear is that my update was too long.
I think you gave a specific example, and your suggestion was constructive.

training.question: What does the speaker praise?
training.feedback: Specific là cụ thể; constructive là mang tính xây dựng.

audio.text: The impact was that the main point came too late.

training.question: What was the problem?
training.feedback: The impact was that nêu hậu quả.

audio.text: I suggest starting with the decision and keeping details short.

training.question: What advice is given?
training.feedback: I suggest + V-ing là cách đề xuất.

audio.text: Thank you for pointing that out. I will take it on board.

training.question: How does the speaker react?
training.feedback: Take on board là tiếp thu.

audio.text: Could you give me an example of a better opening?

training.question: What is requested?
training.feedback: Hỏi thêm ví dụ để hiểu rõ.

audio.text: If I understand correctly, you would like fewer slides.

A meeting with the whole team

pronunciationCues.articulatoryCue: Nhấn âm thứ hai của specific và constructive (spe-CIF-ic, con-STRUC-tive).
pronunciationCues.meaningRisk: Nhấn sai làm từ chính khó nhận ra.

pronunciationCues.articulatoryCue: Nhấn âm thứ hai của suggest (sug-GEST) trong câu đề xuất.
pronunciationCues.meaningRisk: Nhấn âm đầu làm từ khó nhận ra, người nghe có thể không hiểu bạn đang đề xuất.
